sentences.ar: بمدرسة الأحد، كانوا يعطوا تذاكر للحفظ.
sentences.en: At Sunday school, they gave tickets for memorising.

sentences.ar: اللي بيجمع تذاكر كتيرة بياخد كتاب هدية.
sentences.en: Whoever collects many tickets gets a book as a gift.

sentences.ar: توم ما حفظ ولا آية بحياته.
sentences.en: Tom had never memorised a single verse in his life.

sentences.ar: بس كان عنده أشياء بيبادل فيها.
sentences.en: But he had things he could trade with.

sentences.ar: بادل ولاد بتذاكرهم وجمع العدد كله.
sentences.en: He traded with boys for their tickets and collected the whole number.
He went up before the people and took the book.

sentences.ar: القاضي سأله سؤال بسيط عن الكتاب.
sentences.en: The judge asked him a simple question about the book.
Tom did not know the answer and was silent.
The ceremony ended quickly after that.
